sq.q: What is the need for a page replacement algorithm?
answer: When a requested page is not in memory (i.e., a page fault occurs ) and no free frame is available, the OS must select a page to remove to make space. A page replacement algorithm decides which page to replace to minimize future faults and improve efficiency. 📊 Mark Allocation:

sq.q: Describe the Optimal page replacement algorithm. Why is it not used in practice?
answer: Optimal replacement replaces the page that will not be used for the longest time in the future . It gives the lowest number of page faults , but is not practical because it requires future knowledge of page references. Mark Allocation:
